questions.question: Princess Diana was the first wife of which current British king?
questions.explanation: Princess Diana married Prince Charles in 1981, making her the first wife of the man who would later become King Charles III. After their divorce in 1996, Charles went on to marry Camilla Parker Bowles, who became Queen Consort when he ascended to the throne in 2022 following the death of Queen Elizabeth II.

questions.question: To which streaming platform did content creator Valkyrae make her return on January 8, 2025?

Her return to Twitch marked a notable shift in her streaming career and drew significant attention from the gaming and content creation community.

questions.question: In 2009, which stalker was arrested after being discovered blending in with photographers outside Ben Affleck's daughter's preschool and was caught lurking outside the couple's home on multiple occasions?
questions.explanation: Steven Burky was apprehended in 2009 after authorities found he had been disguising himself among paparazzi photographers outside the preschool attended by Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner's daughter. He had also been spotted outside the couple's home on multiple occasions, raising serious security concerns for the family.
